findings.title: Release gate ignores coverage and completeness
evidence: tools/full_domain.py:432-442 compute_gate uses only bySeverity counts
coverage.md can list pending domains while the gate is still computed
no check prevents aggregate without all domains emitted
findings.impact: A partial run (missing domains) can be labelled GO/GO WITH CONDITIONS and be mistaken for a complete audit.
findings.recommendation: Fail or downgrade the gate when any selected domain has not emitted, and record coverage in the gate basis.

findings.title: Registers are generated from report tables, so ID drift is possible across reruns
evidence: tools/full_domain.py:518 lib_findings.collect_with_dupes re-scans the reports it just wrote
findings.impact: Because IDs are assigned during aggregate and read back from Markdown, a manual report edit can silently change the register.
findings.recommendation: Write findings.json and the registers from the same in-memory list, and use findings.json as the source of truth.

report: Synthesis domain. The aggregate step derives the final register from the domain reports; this report verifies the derivation logic.
